40021071.author: पदार्थः
40021071.content: ततः then, तमसि in the darkness, सञ्जाते having arisen, सर्वे all, ते those, देवराक्षसाः gods and demons, अयुद्ध्यन्त fought, बलोन्मत्ताः intoxicated with strength, सूदयन्तः slaying, परस्परम् each other

40021071.author: Translation
40021071.content: Then, with the darkness having arisen, all those gods and demons, intoxicated with their strength, fought, slaying each other.

40021072.author: पदार्थः
40021072.content: ततस्तु then indeed, देवसैन्येन by the army of gods, राक्षसानां of the Rākṣasas, बृहद्बलम् the great army, दशांशं one-tenth, स्थापितं remained, युद्धे in the battle, शेषं the rest, नीतं was led, यमक्षयम् to the abode of Yama.

40021072.author: Translation
40021072.content: Then, by the army of gods, only one-tenth of the great Rākṣasa army remained in the battle, while the rest were sent to the abode of Yama.

40021073.author: पदार्थः
40021073.content: तस्मिंस्तु in that indeed, तामसे dark, युद्धे battle, सर्वे all, ते those, देवराक्षसाः gods and Rākṣasas, अन्योन्यं each other, नाभ्यजानन्त did not recognize, युध्यमानाः fighting, परस्परम् each other.

40021073.author: Translation
40021073.content: In that dark and chaotic battle, all those gods and Rākṣasas, fighting each other, could not recognize one another.

40021074.author: पदार्थः
40021074.content: इन्द्रश्च Indra and, रावणश्चैव Rāvaṇa and indeed, रावणिश्च Rāvaṇi (Indrajit) and, महाबलः the mighty, तस्मिंस्तमोजालवृते in that enveloped in a net of darkness, मोहम् delusion, ईयुः attained, न not, ते those, त्रयः three.

40021074.author: Translation
40021074.content: However, Indra, Rāvaṇa, and the mighty Indrajit, these three, did not fall into delusion in that battle enveloped by a net of darkness.

40021075.author: पदार्थः
40021075.content: स He, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, बलं the army, सर्वं all, रावणो Rāvaṇa, निहतं destroyed, क्षणात् in an instant, क्रोधम् anger, अभ्यगमत attained, तीव्रं intense, महानादं a great roar, च and, मुक्तवान् uttered.

40021075.author: Translation
40021075.content: Seeing his entire army destroyed in an instant, Rāvaṇa indeed became intensely angry and let out a great roar.

40021076.author: पदार्थः
40021076.content: क्रोधात् From anger, सूतं to the charioteer, च and, दुर्धर्षः the formidable one, स्यन्दनस्थम् situated in the chariot, उवाच spoke, ह indeed, परसैन्यस्य of the enemy's army, मध्येन through the middle, यावत् until, अन्तः the end, नयस्व lead, माम् me.

40021076.author: Translation
40021076.content: In his anger, the formidable Rāvaṇa spoke to his charioteer, who was in the chariot, instructing him to drive him through the middle of the enemy's army until its complete destruction.

40021077.author: पदार्थः
40021077.content: अद्य today, एतान् these, त्रिदशान् gods, सर्वान् all, विक्रमैः with valor, समरे in battle, स्वयम् myself, नानाशस्त्रैः with various weapons, महाघोरैः very terrible, नयामि I shall lead, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama.

40021077.author: Translation
40021077.content: Today, I myself shall lead all these gods to the abode of Yama, in battle, with my valor and very terrible, various weapons.

40021078.author: पदार्थः
40021078.content: अहम् I, इन्द्रम् Indra, वधिष्यामि I shall kill, धनदम् Kubera, वरुणम् Varuna, यमम् Yama, त्रिदशान् gods, विनिहत्य having killed completely, अथ then, स्वयम् myself, स्थास्यामि I shall stand, अथोपरि supreme, विषादः sorrow, न not, च and, कर्तव्यः should be done, शीघ्रम् quickly, वाहय drive, मे my, रथम् chariot.

40021078.author: Translation
40021078.content: I shall kill Indra, Kubera, Varuna, and Yama, and having completely slain all the gods, I myself shall then stand supreme; therefore, do not despair, but quickly drive my chariot.

40021079.author: पदार्थः
40021079.content: द्विः twice, खलु indeed, त्वाम् to you, ब्रवीमि I say, अद्य today, यावदन्तः to the very end, नयस्व take, माम् me.

40021079.author: Translation
40021079.content: Indeed, I tell you twice today, take me to the very end (of the journey).

40021080.author: पदार्थः
40021080.content: अयम् this, सः that, नन्दनोद्देशः region of Nandana, यत्र where, वर्तामहे we are, वयम् we, नय take, माम् me, अद्य today, तत्र there, त्वम् you, उदयः Udaya, यत्र where, पर्वतः mountain.

40021080.author: Translation
40021080.content: This is that region of Nandana where we are now; today, you take me to that place where the Udaya mountain is.

40021081.author: पदार्थः
40021081.content: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, तुरगान् horses, सः he, मनोजवान् swift as thought, आदिदेश commanded, अथ then, शत्रूणाम् of the enemies, मध्येन through the midst, एव indeed, च and, सारथिः the charioteer.

40021081.author: Translation
40021081.content: Having heard his command, the charioteer then commanded the horses, swift as thought, to proceed directly through the midst of the enemies.

40021082.author: पदार्थः
40021082.content: तस्य his, तं that, निश्चयं resolve, ज्ञात्वा having known, शक्रः Indra, देवेश्वरः the lord of gods, तदा then, रथस्थः standing in his chariot, समरस्थः standing in battle, तान् those, देवान् gods, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40021082.author: Translation
40021082.content: Then, Indra, the lord of gods, having understood his (Ravana's) determination, spoke these words to the gods who were also present in the battlefield, while he stood in his chariot.

40021083.author: पदार्थः
40021083.content: सुराः O gods, शृणुत listen, मद्वाक्यं to my words, यत् which, तावत् indeed, मम to me, रोचते is pleasing, जीवन् living, एव only, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, साधु properly, रक्षः the demon, निगृह्यताम् let him be captured.

40021083.author: Translation
40021083.content: O gods, listen to my words, which seem good to me: this demon Dashagriva should be captured alive.

40021084.author: पदार्थः
40021084.content: एषः this one, हि indeed, अतिबलः very powerful, सैन्यैः with his armies, रथेन with his chariot, पवनौजसा having the speed of wind, गमिष्यति will proceed, प्रवृद्धोर्मिः with rising waves, समुद्रः an ocean, इव like, पर्वणि on a full moon day.

40021084.author: Translation
40021084.content: This Ravana, indeed very powerful with his armies and his wind-swift chariot, will advance like an ocean with surging waves on a full moon day.

40021085.author: पदार्थः
40021085.content: न not, हि indeed, एषः this one, हन्तुं to kill, शक्यः is possible, अद्य today, वरदानात् due to the boon, सुनिर्भयः very fearless, तत् therefore, ग्रहीष्यामहे we shall capture, रक्षः the demon, यत्ताः prepared, भवत be, संयुगे in battle.

40021085.author: Translation
40021085.content: Indeed, it is not possible to kill him today because he is very fearless due to the boon, therefore, let us capture this demon, and be prepared in battle.

40021086.author: पदार्थः
40021086.content: यथा just as, बलौ Bali, निरुद्धे having been restrained, च and, त्रैलोक्यं the three worlds, भुज्यते are enjoyed, मया by me, एवम् similarly, एतस्य of this, पापस्य wicked one, निरोधः the restraint, मम to me, रोचते is pleasing.

40021086.author: Translation
40021086.content: Just as the three worlds are enjoyed by me after Bali was restrained, similarly, the restraint of this wicked one is pleasing to me.

40021087.author: पदार्थः
40021087.content: ततः then, अन्यम् another, देशम् place, आस्थाय having resorted to, शक्रः Indra, सन्त्यज्य having abandoned, रावणम् Ravana, अयुध्यत fought, महाराज O great king, राक्षसान् the Rakshasas, त्रासयन् terrifying, रणे in battle,

40021087.author: Translation
40021087.content: Then, O great king, Indra, leaving Ravana, took up another position and fought, terrifying the Rakshasas in battle.

40021088.author: पदार्थः
40021088.content: उत्तरेण by the northern side, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), प्रविवेश entered, अनिवर्तकः without retreating, दक्षिणेन by the southern, तु but, पार्श्वेन side, प्रविवेश entered, शतक्रतुः Shatakratu (Indra),

40021088.author: Translation
40021088.content: Dashagriva entered from the northern side without retreating, while Shatakratu entered from the southern side.

40021089.author: पदार्थः
40021089.content: ततः then, स he, योजनशतम् a hundred yojanas, प्रविष्टः having advanced, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of Rakshasas, देवतानाम् of the gods, बलम् army, सर्वम् all, शरवर्षैः with showers of arrows, अवाकिरत् covered,

40021089.author: Translation
40021089.content: Then, having advanced a hundred yojanas, the lord of Rakshasas covered the entire army of the gods with showers of arrows.

40021090.author: पदार्थः
40021090.content: ततः then, शक्रः Indra, निरीक्ष्य having seen, अथ then, प्रनष्टम् routed, तु indeed, स्वकम् his own, बलम् army, न्यवर्तयत् turned back (to face), असम्भ्रान्तः unperturbed, समावृत्य having turned towards, दशाननम् Dashanana (Ravana),

40021090.author: Translation
40021090.content: Then, seeing his own army routed, Indra, unperturbed, turned back to face Dashanana.

40021091.author: पदार्थः
40021091.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, नादः a cry, मुक्तः was let out, दानवराक्षसैः by the Danavas and Rakshasas, हा alas, हताः killed, स्म indeed, इति thus, ग्रस्तम् seized, दृष्ट्वा having seen, शक्रेण by Indra, रावणम् Ravana,

40021091.author: Translation
40021091.content: In the meantime, the Danavas and Rakshasas, seeing Ravana seized by Indra, let out a cry of "Alas, we are indeed killed!"

40021092.author: पदार्थः
40021092.content: ततः then, रथम् chariot, समास्थाय having mounted, रावणिः Ravana's son (Indrajit), क्रोधमूर्च्छितः overcome with rage, तत्सैन्यम् that army, अतिसङ्क्रुद्धः extremely enraged, प्रविवेश entered, सुदारुणम् very terrible (army)

40021092.author: Translation
40021092.content: Then, Indrajit, consumed by extreme rage, mounted his chariot and furiously entered that formidable army.

40021093.author: पदार्थः
40021093.content: ताम् that, प्रविश्य having entered, महामायां great illusion, प्राप्ताम् obtained, गोपतिना by the lord of cows (Indra), पुरा formerly, प्रविवेश entered, सुसंरब्धः greatly agitated, तत्सैन्यम् that army, समभिद्रवत् attacked

40021093.author: Translation
40021093.content: Having entered that great illusion, which was formerly obtained by Indra, Indrajit, greatly agitated, entered and attacked that army.

40021094.author: पदार्थः
40021094.content: सः he (Indrajit), सर्वाः all, देवताः gods, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, शक्रम् Indra, एव only, अभ्यधावत rushed towards, महेन्द्रः Mahendra (Indra), च and, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, न not, अपश्यत् saw, च and, सुतम् son, रिपोः of the enemy (Indrajit)

40021094.author: Translation
40021094.content: Indrajit, disregarding all other gods, rushed only towards Indra, but the greatly effulgent Mahendra could not see the enemy's son.

40021095.author: पदार्थः
40021095.content: विमुक्तकवचः without armor, तत्र there, वध्यमानः being struck, अपि even, रावणिः Ravana's son (Indrajit), त्रिदशैः by the gods, सुमहावीर्यैः of great valor, न not, चकार did, च and, किञ्चन anything (to him)

40021095.author: Translation
40021095.content: Even though Indrajit was without armor and being struck there by the exceedingly valiant gods, he did not suffer any harm.

40021096.author: पदार्थः
40021096.content: सः he (Indrajit), मातलिम् Matali (Indra's charioteer), समायान्तम् approaching, ताडयित्वा having struck, शरोत्तमैः with excellent arrows, महेन्द्रम् Mahendra (Indra), बाणवर्षेण with a shower of arrows, भूयः again, एव only, अभ्यवाकिरत् covered/showered

40021096.author: Translation
40021096.content: Having struck Matali, who was approaching, with excellent arrows, Indrajit then again showered Mahendra with a volley of arrows.

40021097.author: पदार्थः
40021097.content: ततः then, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, रथं the chariot, शक्रः Indra, विससर्ज dismissed, च and, सारथिम् the charioteer, ऐरावतं Airavata, समारुह्य having mounted, मृगयामास searched for, रावणिम् Ravana's son.

40021097.author: Translation
40021097.content: Then, Indra abandoned his chariot and dismissed his charioteer, and having mounted Airavata, he searched for Ravana's son.

40021098.author: पदार्थः
40021098.content: सः he, तत्र there, मायाबलवान् powerful with illusion, अदृश्यः invisible, अथ then, अन्तरिक्षगः moving in the sky, इन्द्रं Indra, मायापरिक्षिप्तं enveloped in illusion, कृत्वा having made, सः he, प्राद्रवत् attacked, शरैः with arrows.

40021098.author: Translation
40021098.content: There, Indrajit, powerful with illusion and invisible, moving in the sky, enveloped Indra in illusion and then attacked him with arrows.

40021099.author: पदार्थः
40021099.content: सः he, तं him, यदा when, परिश्रान्तं exhausted, इन्द्रं Indra, जज्ञे knew, अथ then, रावणिः Ravana's son, तदा then, एनं him, मायया with illusion, बद्ध्वा having bound, स्वसैन्यम् to his own army, अभितः around, अनयत् led.

40021099.author: Translation
40021099.content: When Ravana's son knew Indra to be exhausted, he then bound him with illusion and led him around his own army.

40021100.author: पदार्थः
40021100.content: तं him, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, बलात् by force, तेन by him, नीयमानं being led, महारणात् from the great battle, महेन्द्रम् the great Indra, अमराः the gods, सर्वे all, किं what, नु indeed, स्यात् would happen, इति thus, अचिन्तयन् thought.

40021100.author: Translation
40021100.content: Having seen the great Indra being led away by force from the great battle by him, all the gods wondered what would happen next.

40021101.author: पदार्थः
40021101.content: दृश्यते is seen, न not, सः he, मायावी the illusionist, शक्रजित् Indrajit, समितिञ्जयः conqueror in battle, विद्यावान् knowledgeable, अपि even, येन by whom, इन्द्रः Indra, मायया by illusion, नीयते is led, बलात् by force.

40021101.author: Translation
40021101.content: The illusionist Indrajit, the conqueror in battle, is not seen, by whom even the knowledgeable Indra is being led away by force through illusion.

40021102.author: पदार्थः
40021102.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे meantime, क्रुद्धाः enraged, सर्वे all, सुरगणाः hosts of gods, तदा then, रावणं Ravana, विमुखीकृत्य having turned away (defeated), शरवर्षैः with showers of arrows, अवाकिरन् showered upon.

40021102.author: Translation
40021102.content: At that moment, all the enraged hosts of gods, having defeated Ravana, showered him with torrents of arrows.

40021103.author: पदार्थः
40021103.content: रावणः Ravana, तु but, समासाद्य having encountered, आदित्यान् Adityas, च and, वसून् Vasus, तदा then, न not, शशाक was able, स he, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, योद्धुं to fight, शत्रुभिः by enemies, अर्दितः afflicted.

40021103.author: Translation
40021103.content: But Ravana, having encountered the Adityas and Vasus, was then unable to fight in battle, being tormented by his enemies.

40021104.author: पदार्थः
40021104.content: स he, तं him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, परिम्लानं greatly exhausted, प्रहारैः by blows, जर्जरीकृतम् shattered, रावणिः Ravani (Indrajit), पितरं father, युद्धे in battle, दर्शनस्थः standing in sight, अब्रवीत् spoke, इदम् this.

40021104.author: Translation
40021104.content: Seeing his father greatly exhausted and shattered by the blows in battle, Indrajit, standing visible, spoke these words to him.

40021105.author: पदार्थः
40021105.content: आगच्छ come, तात father, गच्छामः let us go, रणकर्म the act of war, निवर्तताम् let it cease. जितं victory, नः our, विदितं known, ते to you, अस्तु let it be. स्वस्थः well, भव be, गतज्वरः free from distress.

40021105.author: Translation
40021105.content: "Come, father, let us go; let this fighting cease, for our victory is known to you; be well and free from distress."

40021106.author: पदार्थः
40021106.content: अयम् this one, हि indeed, सुरसैन्यस्य of the army of gods, त्रैलोक्यस्य of the three worlds, च and, यः who, प्रभुः lord, स he, गृहीतः captured, दैवबलात् by divine power. भग्नदर्पाः with broken pride, सुराः gods, कृताः made.

40021106.author: Translation
40021106.content: "Indeed, this one who is the lord of the army of gods and of the three worlds has been captured by divine power, and thus the gods have been rendered with broken pride."

40021107.author: पदार्थः
40021107.content: यथेष्टम् as desired, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy, लोकान्त्रीन् three worlds, निगृह्य having subdued, अरातिम् the enemy, ओजसा with might, वृथा in vain, किम् why, ते your, श्रमेण with effort, इह here, युद्धम् battle, अद्य today, तु indeed, निष्फलम् fruitless, ...

40021107.author: Translation
40021107.content: Enjoy the three worlds to your heart's content, having subdued the enemy with your might; why exert yourself in vain here, for today's battle is indeed fruitless.

40021108.author: पदार्थः
40021108.content: ततः then, ते those, दैवतगणाः hosts of gods, निवृत्ताः ceased, रणकर्मणः from the act of battle, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, रावणेः of Ravani (Indrajit), वाक्यम् speech, स्वस्थचेताः with a calm mind, बभूव became, ह indeed, ...

40021108.author: Translation
40021108.content: Then, having heard that speech of Indrajit, those hosts of gods ceased from the act of battle and indeed became composed.

40021109.author: पदार्थः
40021109.content: अथ then, सः he, रणविगतज्वरः free from the fever of battle, प्रभुः lord, विजयम् victory, अवाप्य having obtained, निशाचराधिपः lord of night-wanderers (Ravana), स्वभवनम् to his own palace, अभितः towards, जगाम went, हृष्टः delighted, स्वसुतम् his own son, अवाप्य having met, च and, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, ...

40021109.author: Translation
40021109.content: Then, Ravana, the lord of night-wanderers, having obtained victory and being free from the fever of battle, went joyfully towards his own palace and, having met his son, spoke these words.

40021110.author: पदार्थः
40021110.content: अतिबलसदृशैः with exceedingly mighty, पराक्रमैः valorous deeds, तैः by those, मम my, कुलमान family's honor, विवर्धनम् enhancement, कृतम् has been done, यत् that, अयम् this, अतुल्यबलः of incomparable strength, त्वया by you, अद्य today, वै indeed, त्रिदशपतिः lord of the thirty (Indra), त्रिदशाः the thirty (gods), च and, निर्जिताः conquered, ...

40021110.author: Translation
40021110.content: By those exceedingly mighty valorous deeds, my family's honor has been greatly enhanced, for today, this Indra of incomparable strength and the other gods have indeed been conquered by you.

40021111.author: पदार्थः
40021111.content: नय take, रथम् chariot, अधिरोप्य having placed upon, वासवम् Vasava (Indra), नगरम् to the city, इतः from here, व्रज go, सेनया by the army, वृतः surrounded, त्वम् you, अहम् I, अपि also, तव your, गच्छतः while going, द्रुतम् quickly, सह with, सचिवैः ministers, अनुयामि will follow, पृष्ठतः from behind, ...

40021111.author: Translation
40021111.content: Take Vasava (Indra), place him on the chariot, and you, surrounded by the army, go from here to the city; I also, with my ministers, will quickly follow behind you as you go.

40021112.author: पदार्थः
40021112.content: अथ then, सः he, बलवृतः surrounded by his army, सवाहनः with his vehicles, त्रिदशपतिं the lord of the gods, परिगृह्य having seized, रावणिः Ravana's son, स्वभवनम् his own abode, अभिगम्य having reached, वीर्यवान् the valiant one, कृतसमरान् those who had fought the battle, विससर्ज dismissed, राक्षसान् the Rakshasas.

40021112.author: Translation
40021112.content: Then, the valiant son of Ravana, Indrajit, having captured the lord of the gods along with his vehicles and surrounded by his army, returned to his own abode and dismissed the Rakshasas who had fought the battle.
